'''Trevon Rey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He came under the sway of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] on a search mission for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kirlocca]] in the [[Almas Wasteland]]s.

==Biography==
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] near birth, Trevon Rey was taken from his homeworld to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After passing through one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academies]] and passing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] after spending time as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Rey was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="LFC" />

Stationed at the [[Almas Academy|academy]] on [[Almas]] under Headmaster [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], Rey served the Order proudly and continued his studies in the Force. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Rey was at the Academy when a group of terrorists attacked the [[Remembrance Hall]]. Master Qel-Bertuk issued an order to all Jedi, demanding they return to the Academy; however, Master [[Kirlocca]] and his charges do not respond from their location in the [[Almas Wasteland]]. Qel-Bertuk then assembled a team of Jedi, led by [[Tantron Dow]], and including his Padawan [[Alkin Saad]], Jedi Rey, [[Seeth'tal]], and [[Syr Tal-Soten]] to located and escort Kirlocca and his students back to the academy. While the team wandered through the wastelands, Tal-Soten received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of Master Kirlocca's betrayal of the Order, and all present became convinced of this inevitable occurrence. In fact, the Jedi had been affected by the strong surge in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that was present in the wastelands, and they all had become deranged. Crashing their shuttle in the wastelands, the deranged rescue team continued on foot on their hunt for Kirlocca.<ref name="LFC" />

Having lost contact with the academy, Qel-Bertuk sent out another search team to recover the first and Master Kirlocca. The second team discovered the downed shuttle being picked apart by [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] salvagers and stop to search it. Inside they discover Padawan Saad's body and the confused and frantic [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] Master Dow. After calming the crazed Jedi, he directs them down the path Jedi Rey and the others had gone in search of Kirlocca. Arriving at Kirlocca's abandoned campsite where Rey and his group had killed a Jedi and injured Padawan [[Hary'nkel]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl reveals that Tal-Soten and his group had attacked them and the others had fled further into the wastes. Following the sounds of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], the second search party comes across Jedi Rey engaged in fighting Kirlocca and his surviving campers. The search party quickly help subdue Rey, Seeth'tal, and Sal-Toten, all of whom were taken back to the academy for evaluation and possibly freeing themselves from their struggle over the dark side.<ref name="LFC" />
